items.name: Replace the divisions CSV with a junction table

items.name: Constrain columns added by later ALTER passes
items.note: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cannot add a constraint, so users.client_id, users.worker_id, clients.account_manager_id and shifts.client_id are unconstrained. shifts.client_id has no FK and no index despite being joined in scheduling.php

items.name: Extend soft delete to records that cascade
items.note: 11 of 50 tables have deleted_at. invoices cascade to credit_notes, incidents to incident_actions, and timesheets hold pay evidence with neither deleted_at nor updated_at

items.name: Close the unauthenticated write on api.php
items.note: SECURITY. server/api.php POST has no require_auth and no rate_limit: anyone can insert unbounded rows into `items` on production. Smoke-test table, so no data is exposed, but it is an open write

items.name: Role-restrict worker reads
items.note: SECURITY. server/workers.php GET has no require_role (checks are only on the write paths at :36,:58,:74), so any authenticated account -- including a client portal login -- can read every worker's pay_rate_pence, dbs_status and sia_number

items.name: Role-restrict the shared mailbox
items.note: SECURITY. server/inbox.php:13 calls require_auth only. Any authenticated account can read the whole company mailbox and send replies as the company

items.name: Role-restrict field event logging
items.note: SECURITY. server/field.php:9 calls require_auth only and never require_role. Any authenticated account can post events -- including panic alerts and clock-ins -- against any shift id

items.name: Update last_seen_at on token use
items.note: Written once at issue (server/auth.php:42) and never updated, so the session list shows creation time under a last-activity heading
